question_summary: Reinforcement for the transfer beam conflicts between Structural General Notes S-001 and Sheet S-301 (additional #5 ties); after initial resolution favoring S-301, field asks whether this applies to all transfer beams on the level or just the one originally called out.
routing_rationale: This is a document discrepancy in structural reinforcement details, so it is routed to the Structural Engineer as the design professional of record for that discipline.
